notes.title: Demo Update v.0.1.2
notes.notes:
Long time no see!

It has been a little while since the last update, many apologies! Unfortunately, there had been delays with some features in this update and on top of that, there was Gamescom the last week here in our hometown of Cologne. So a bit of time and effort went into prepping for the convention. But good news is there is finally a new update with some improvements and new features. 

First off, we had the request to add in a save system. With the addition of the progression tree, the demo has become quite a bit longer than we initially had planned. So, a way to save your progress was long overdue! It has not been playtested to the fullest extent yet, so if you do encounter any problems with it, please report them over on the discord. Many thanks!!

Almost more important than adding a way to save was actually fixing the customer spawn rates. Something was pretty broken here, without going into too much detail: We should have our customers back, ideally a lot of them! 

This brings us to one more feature: the trash can. To help out with the trash these new customers will most definitely leave behind, we added a way to keep the outside of the kiosk clean. The trash can must be unlocked first and can then be bought in the shop. It forced customers to throw away any trash they have instead of throwing it on the ground.

Now at last but definitely not least we have a great new addition to our Kiosk staff: the Chefin. The Chef's wife is now a playable character, besides the OG Chef. Until they get to manage and fight alongside, you have to decide which character you want to play when starting a new singleplayer game (only visual/cosmetic currently).

This wraps up most changes from this update. Check out all the changes below!

Let us know what you think about these new features. Many thanks and until next time (hopefully not in a month)!

Neptun Interactive


All changes

Fixed customer spawn rates

Added Save system

Added Chefin (character selection)

Added customer level system

Added trash can

Balanced weather/event effects

Added better customer speech bubbles

notes.title: Demo Update v.0.1.1
notes.notes:
Hello Friends!

First small update for the demo. We have improved on a few balancing issues, mostly making sure that there are more customers visiting the Kiosk. Also, the item skill tree has been heavily expanded, so you can now unlock a lot more wares than before. Check out all changes below!

Let us know what you think about these new features. Many thanks and until next time!

Neptun Interactive


All changes

Fixed shop item names

Balanced Customer stats/spawn rates

Added Skill Tree info Box

Fixed Carton/Crate stacking

Added budget Game Over

Fixed Recycling (Trashbags)

Added ordering rules to PC

notes.title: DEMO Release
notes.notes:
A milestone achieved




[img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//44788849/c84909926e006feb837db95ab99830e900104dbe.png"]






Public demo is out!

After 6 months of close internal development, we are proud to announce the release of our first public demo - we sincerely hope you enjoy it! Expect never-before-seen gameplay features like a full CooP-Mode, wares and price progression, and a full-fledged skill tree for the Chef and his lovely wife! We also welcome you to join our new, dedicated Discord server to share feedback and questions or to mingle and philosophize about gaming in general: 

https://discord.gg/Wq6jvjS34Y







[img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//44788849/a71aec91e38be47b81593e36d6d0557063df4b45.png"]






The last six months were stressful, and we want to apologize for being quiet on our socials and in here. We promise to give our best to stay more public from this day onwards, so feel free to also check "Neptun Interactive" on Instagram and TikTok. While the important stuff will be posted here and on Discord, some behind-the-scenes tomfoolery awaits you there, when you check in from time to time.



But enough talking - play and enjoy the demo and let us know how you feel about it at Discord: 

https://discord.gg/Wq6jvjS34Y

 See you soon, we look forward to hearing about your endeavours to become a kiosk-shop imperator! Neptun out - until next time!
